# Test candidate T forms: fit sigma = f_poly(eps) + a*h(T) for various h
def test(h,name):
    B=np.column_stack([eps**i for i in range(6)]+[h]);
    cc=np.linalg.lstsq(B,sigma,rcond=None)[0]; r=sigma-B@cc
    print(name,"NMSE %.3e"%(np.mean(r**2)/np.var(sigma)), np.round(cc[-1],4))
test(T,"T");test(T**2,"T2");test(np.exp(-T),"exp-T");test(1/T,"1/T");test(np.log(T),"logT");test(np.exp(T),"expT");test(1/T**2,"1/T2");test(np.exp(-1/T),"exp-1/T")
